about_the_role: Pixelworks builds customer-facing dashboards for healthcare providers. Accessibility and performance are product requirements, not afterthoughts.
responsibilities: Build responsive user interfaces in React that work from 320px mobile widths upward.
Translate Figma designs into accurate, accessible and reusable components.
Consume REST APIs, handling loading, empty and error states explicitly.
Ensure interfaces meet WCAG accessibility guidelines including keyboard navigation.
Optimise bundle size and rendering performance for low-bandwidth users.
Write component tests and participate in design and code review.
required_skills: Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals including flexbox, grid and the box model.
Proficiency in modern JavaScript including ES6 features, promises and async/await.
Solid React experience with hooks, component composition and state management.
Ability to build Responsive Design layouts that adapt across screen sizes.
Experience consuming REST APIs from the browser and handling failures gracefully.
Version control with Git in a team setting.
preferred_skills: Experience with Tailwind CSS or another utility-first styling approach.
Familiarity with Next.js for server rendering and routing.
State management with Redux or a modern alternative.
Knowledge of Web Accessibility standards and assistive technology testing.
Experience with Vite or Webpack build tooling.
Component testing with Jest or React Testing Library.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a technical field or an equivalent portfolio.
A portfolio of deployed interfaces you designed or implemented.
